$comment: The units of this language: which teaching points, in which order, with which worksheet types. Everything else in a unit is filled by scripts/units/assemble.js. status 'pilot' = noindex, in no sitemap, linked from nowhere. A lesson's screen activity must not run ahead of the teaching (an activity with subtraction before the subtraction lesson): name it per lesson ("activity") or set it to null to use a page of the lesson that checks the answers.

units.subject: math
units.title: Addition and Subtraction Within 10
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Math Lesson Plans: Addition and Subtraction Within 10
units.metaDescription: A five-week Grade 1 math unit: 8 lessons on adding and subtracting within 10, each with a teacher note, practice pages (most at three levels), and on-screen practice.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Hearing Sounds in Words
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Reading and Writing Lesson Plans: Hearing Sounds in Words
units.metaDescription: A three-week Kindergarten unit: 6 lessons from rhyme and syllables to sound boxes and first CVC words. The last two are for children who know most letter sounds.

units.subject: math
units.title: Position Words, Size, and Patterns
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Position Words, Size, and Patterns
units.metaDescription: A three-week Kindergarten math unit: 6 lessons on position words, searching a picture, comparing sizes, and repeating patterns, each with a teacher note.

units.subject: math
units.title: Counting to 10
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Counting to 10
units.metaDescription: A five-week Kindergarten math unit: 12 lessons on counting and writing numbers to 10, quick looks, matching and comparing groups, and one more and one less.

titles.K-266: Color by Number: Shapes with a Code

units.subject: math
units.title: Shapes All Around
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Shapes All Around
units.metaDescription: A three-week Kindergarten math unit: 5 lessons on naming shapes, counting sides, flat and solid shapes, building with tangram pieces, and mirror pictures.

units.subject: math
units.title: Counting in Order to 20
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Counting in Order to 20
units.metaDescription: A three-week Kindergarten math unit: 7 lessons on writing 11 to 20, counting up to 20 things, counting forward and back, counting on, and first, second, third.

units.subject: math
units.title: Sorting, Tallies, and the Days of the Week
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Sorting, Tallies, and Days of the Week
units.metaDescription: A three-week Kindergarten math unit: 5 lessons on counting each kind, tally marks, estimating, heavier and lighter, and the days of the week, with teacher notes.

units.subject: math
units.title: Adding and Taking Away Within 10
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Adding and Taking Away Within 10
units.metaDescription: A two-week Kindergarten math unit: 4 lessons on putting two groups together, taking away on a ten-frame, and addition and take-away stories within 10.

units.subject: math
units.title: Number Bonds and Partners of 10
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Number Bonds and Partners of 10
units.metaDescription: A four-week Kindergarten math unit: 8 lessons on number bonds to 10, taking apart 6 to 9, and the partners of 10, with a first look at partners of 20.

units.subject: math
units.title: Teen Numbers and Counting to 100
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Math Lesson Plans: Teen Numbers and Counting to 100
units.metaDescription: A four-week Kindergarten math unit: 8 lessons on teen numbers as ten and some more, counting to 50 and to 100, counting on from any number, and counting by tens.

units.subject: math
units.title: Doubles, Three Addends, and Addition Pyramids
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Lesson Plans: Doubles, Three Addends, and Addition Pyramids
units.metaDescription: A five-week Grade 1 math unit: 8 lessons on doubles and near doubles, making ten, thinking addition to subtract, true or false equations, odd and even, and three addends.

units.subject: math
units.title: Tens and Ones
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Math Lesson Plans: Tens and Ones
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 1 math unit: 6 lessons on teen numbers, counting tens, tens and ones, number words, comparing two-digit numbers, and the number of the day.

units.subject: math
units.title: The Hundreds Chart and Skip Counting
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Math Lesson Plans: The Hundreds Chart and Skip Counting
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 1 math unit: 4 lessons on the number line, the hundreds chart, 10 more and 10 less, and skip counting, with practice pages at three levels.

units.subject: math
units.title: Adding Within 100
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Math Lesson Plans: Adding Within 100
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 1 math unit: 5 lessons on adding tens, subtracting tens, adding ones with and without a new ten, and adding two-digit numbers with rods and cubes.

units.subject: math
units.title: Time, Calendar, and Coins
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Math Lesson Plans: Time, Calendar, and Coins
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 1 math unit: 6 lessons on time to the hour and half hour, matching clocks, the calendar, ordinal numbers, and counting coins, with teacher notes.

units.subject: math
units.title: Shapes, Measuring, and Graphs
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Math Lesson Plans: Shapes, Measuring, and Graphs
units.metaDescription: A five-week Grade 1 math unit: 8 lessons on shapes, tangram puzzles, measuring length, sorting, picture and bar graphs, patterns, and halves and fourths.

units.subject: math
units.title: Place Value to 1,000
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Math Lesson Plans: Place Value to 1,000
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 2 math unit: 8 lessons that review tens and ones and skip counting, then teach hundreds, expanded form, comparing, and 100 more and 100 less.

units.subject: math
units.title: Adding and Subtracting Within 100
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Math Lesson Plans: Adding and Subtracting Within 100
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 2 math unit: 6 lessons on number lines, jumps on the hundreds chart and on an open number line, adding and subtracting in columns, and mixed practice.

units.subject: math
units.title: Adding and Subtracting Within 1,000
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Math Lesson Plans: Adding and Subtracting Within 1,000
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 2 math unit: 5 lessons on adding and subtracting three-digit numbers with blocks and in columns, with a new ten or hundred and across zeros.

units.subject: math
units.title: Measurement, Time, and Money
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Math Lesson Plans: Measurement, Time, and Money
units.metaDescription: A five-week Grade 2 math unit: 7 lessons on measuring with a ruler, time to five minutes, the calendar, counting mixed coins, and shopping with money.

units.subject: math
units.title: Graphs and Grids
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Math Lesson Plans: Graphs and Grids
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 2 math unit: 5 lessons on making a graph from counts, bar graphs, and line plots, with a first look at picture graphs with a key and at grids.

units.subject: math
units.title: Equal Groups and Equal Shares
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Math Lesson Plans: Equal Groups and Equal Shares
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 2 math unit: 7 lessons on odd and even, equal groups, arrays, sharing, and halves, thirds, and fourths, with a first look at the multiplication sign.

units.subject: math
units.title: Shapes, Solids, and Symmetry
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Math Lesson Plans: Shapes, Solids, and Symmetry
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 2 math unit: 6 lessons on sorting shapes by sides; solid shapes and their faces, edges, and vertices; and a first look at symmetry, with teacher notes.

units.subject: math
units.title: Rounding, Adding, and Subtracting Within 1,000
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Lesson Plans: Rounding, Adding, and Subtracting Within 1,000
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 3 math unit: 7 lessons on rounding to the nearest ten and hundred, estimating sums, regrouping, the equal sign, odd and even sums, and patterns.

units.subject: math
units.title: Starting Multiplication
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Math Lesson Plans: Starting Multiplication
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 3 math unit: 5 lessons on equal groups and arrays, hops on a number line, turning an array, the 2 and 5 times tables, and number machines.

units.subject: math
units.title: Division
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Math Lesson Plans: Division
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 3 math unit: 6 lessons on sharing, making groups, fact families, the facts still to learn, and word problems, with a first look at remainders.

units.subject: math
units.title: Time, Temperature, Mass, and Liquid Volume
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Math Lesson Plans: Time, Temperature, Mass, and Liquid Volume
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 3 math unit: 7 lessons on time to the minute, elapsed time, a thermometer, grams on a scale, milliliters in a cup, plus a first look at 24-hour time.

units.subject: math
units.title: Area and Perimeter
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Math Lesson Plans: Area and Perimeter
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 3 math unit: 5 lessons, four on area as rows times columns and perimeter as the distance around, and one extra lesson on counting the cubes in a solid.

units.subject: math
units.title: Fractions
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Math Lesson Plans: Fractions
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 3 math unit: 8 lessons on equal parts, naming fractions, the whole, fractions on a number line, comparing, and equivalent fractions.

units.subject: math
units.title: Shapes and Data
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Math Lesson Plans: Shapes and Data
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 3 math unit: 5 lessons on right angles, rectangles and squares, scaled graphs, and line plots, with a first look at lines of symmetry.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Letters and Handwriting
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Reading and Writing Lesson Plans: Letters and Handwriting
units.metaDescription: A three-week Kindergarten unit: 7 lessons on pencil strokes, finding and matching letters, writing letters, the alphabet in order, and first words to trace.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: First Words to Read
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Reading and Writing Lesson Plans: First Words to Read
units.metaDescription: A three-week Kindergarten unit: 5 lessons on matching words to pictures, sight words, one and many, a or an, and sh and ch, each with a teacher note.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Sorting, Opposites, and Story Order
units.metaTitle: Kindergarten Reading Lesson Plans: Sorting, Opposites, and Story Order
units.metaDescription: A two-week Kindergarten unit: 4 lessons on sorting pictures into groups, which one does not belong, opposites, and putting a story in order.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Sounds, Spelling, and Syllables
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Lesson Plans: Sounds, Spelling, and Syllables
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 1 unit on short vowels and digraphs: 6 lessons on rhymes, word families, sound boxes, the digraphs sh, ch, th, spelling picture words, and syllables.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Reading Sentences and Stories
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Lesson Plans: Reading Sentences and Stories
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 1 unit: 5 lessons on reading and following a sentence, missing words, mixed-up sentences, question words, and story order, with teacher notes.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Words and How They Work
units.metaTitle: Grade 1 Reading and Writing Lesson Plans: Words and How They Work
units.metaDescription: A four-week Grade 1 unit: 8 lessons on ABC order, parts of speech (nouns, verbs, adjectives), pronouns, a and an, opposites, synonyms, shades of meaning, and root words.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Sentences and Grammar
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Reading and Writing Lesson Plans: Sentences and Grammar
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 2 unit: 6 lessons on capital letters and end marks, parts of speech (nouns, verbs, adjectives), plurals, verb forms, pronouns, and writing questions.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Spelling, Word Building, and Word Choice
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Lesson Plans: Spelling, Word Building, and Word Choice
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 2 unit: 6 lessons that review the digraph sh, then teach spelling rules, compound words, root words, synonyms, and more exact words for "said."

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Reading Stories and Writing
units.metaTitle: Grade 2 Lesson Plans: Reading Stories and Writing
units.metaDescription: A three-week Grade 2 unit: 6 lessons on answering story questions, missing words, writing about a picture, retelling, an animal fact sheet, and a first look at cursive.

titles.G2-339: Animal Fact File: Circle the True Facts
titles.G2-340: Animal Fact File with a Word Bank

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Words and Their Meanings
units.metaTitle: Grade 3 Reading and Writing Lesson Plans: Words and Their Meanings
units.metaDescription: A two-week Grade 3 unit: 4 lessons on prefixes, more exact words for "go" and "look," words that name a person, such as "baker," and choosing the right form of a word.
